data.content_ref: inline:The contradiction relation is only a single-axis incompatibility (a mutation named 'generic_exception' can pass the typed-code check while failing the name-description check), and the refutation-if (framework coupling naming to types) is not evaluated or argued away — it is left as a bare conditional that, if true, would dissolve the contradiction entirely. The target neither affirms the coupling is absent nor argues that the framework cannot couple them; it simply stops at the conditional. An unaddressed refutation-if that would negate the relation leaves the contradiction unestablished rather than substantively demonstrated.
